paragraphs.label: Opening narrative
paragraphs.text: The patient, Dummy Echo, is a 35-year-old male with a history of post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) with nightmares and passive suicidal thoughts, admitted to partial hospitalization on 2026-09-28.

paragraphs.label: Psychiatric history
paragraphs.text: The patient has a history of one prior suicide attempt by overdose in 2018 and one prior hospitalization.

paragraphs.label: Medical history
paragraphs.text: The patient has a history of asthma.

paragraphs.label: Family psychiatric history
paragraphs.text: The patient's father has a history of alcohol use disorder.

paragraphs.label: Substance use history
paragraphs.text: The patient reports drinking six beers most nights at admission and has not had a drink since starting the program, with a total of 21 days of sobriety.

paragraphs.label: Program course by problem
paragraphs.text: The patient reports a significant reduction in nightmares, down to once a week, and improved sleep duration of about six hours.

paragraphs.label: Response to interventions
paragraphs.text: The patient's risk of self-harm has decreased, with no thoughts of hurting himself for the past two weeks.

paragraphs.label: Condition at discharge
paragraphs.text: The patient is stable for discharge to outpatient care.

paragraphs.label: Discharge risk assessment
paragraphs.text: The patient's risk is assessed as low.

paragraphs.label: Discharge medications / follow-up / disposition
paragraphs.text: The patient is currently taking prazosin 2 milligrams at bedtime and sertraline 100 milligrams. The patient will see Dr. Rivera for medication management in one week and Ms. Patel for therapy every Tuesday. The patient has the crisis line number 988.
